# Bhalaji Yadav Kantepalle — Research Portfolio

> Public academic portfolio for a Ph.D. student at Virginia Commonwealth University studying stimuli-responsive soft and liquid-crystalline materials through quantitative metrology, rheology, neutron scattering, mechanics, and reproducible computation.

## Primary pages
- [Research program](https://bhalaji.com/research/): Stable overview of the governing problem, research pillars, application horizons, and collaboration questions.
- [First-author article](https://bhalaji.com/publication/adhesives-wearable/): Multi-criteria adhesive selection for wearable textiles.
- [M.S. thesis record](https://bhalaji.com/publication/masters-thesis/): Public degree and repository information; full manuscript embargoed until July 20, 2031.
- [Research software](https://bhalaji.com/project/peel-trace-evaluation/): Versioned workflow for protocol-defined peel-trace analysis.
- [Curriculum vitae](https://bhalaji.com/uploads/resume.pdf): Generated CV.
